Json

Table of Contents

  • parse

The Json module provides functions for serializing Silk values into JSON strings
and parsing JSON formatted strings into native Silk values.

parse

Signature
parse(json_string: String) -> Any

Parses a JSON string into corresponding Silk data structures (Maps, Lists, Strings, Numbers, Bools, Null).

Parameters:
- json_string: Target JSON string to decode.

Returns:
- Any: Decoded Silk value representation or Null on parse failure.

Usage: 
var data = parse("{\"name\": \"Silk\", \"version\": 1}")

stringify

Signature
stringify(val: Any) -> String

Converts a Silk value or data structure into a valid JSON string.

Parameters:
- val: The value to serialize into JSON format.

Returns:
- String: JSON encoded string representation.

Usage: 
var json_str = stringify(data)
